model_annotation: The chart presents data on enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021. It consists of three pie charts, each representing a different aspect of the data. The first pie chart shows the number of enterprises, with four categories: Industry (61%), Construction (19.0 mln), Trade (8%), and Other Services (12%). The second pie chart displays the number of persons employed, with Construction (51%) having the largest share, followed by Trade (19%), Industry (21%), and Other Services (9%). The third pie chart illustrates the turnover, with Trade (33%) leading, followed by Industry (31%), Construction (6%), and Other Services (9.9 tl). Each pie chart includes a legend indicating the color coding for each industry, and the percentages are labeled inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
